references.text: The preceding verse describes the gold plate that is to be fastened with the blue cord mentioned in verse 37
Fulfilling the instruction to attach the holy plate with a blue cord to the turban
The turban (מִצְנֶפֶת) is first mentioned here as part of the priestly garments
The blue color (תְּכֵלֶת) is also used in the robe beneath the ephod
A blue cord (פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת) is also used in the tassels on the garments as a reminder of the Lord's commands
Moses places the gold plate on the turban when Aaron is consecrated for service
Instruction to put the turban on Aaron's head with the holy diadem
The physical diadem on the high priest's forehead is the concrete typology for the metaphorical requirement to carry God's words on the forehead.
